description_en: Calls the GetMetricsOfResource operation to retrieve metric data for a resource
description_zh: 调用GetMetricsOfResource接口获取资源metric数据
kebab_example: aliyun ahas-openapi get-metrics-of-resource --namespace default --app-name ahas-demo --resource handleService --start-time 1596081600000 --end-time 1596081780000 --ahas-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetMetricsOfResource

parameters.help_en: The application name. If the application is an EDAS application, AppName is the App ID in EDAS. You can view the corresponding ID in the EDAS console by navigating to Application Management > Basic Information
parameters.help_zh: 应用名，若为EDAS应用，则AppName为EDAS中的App ID，可在EDAS控制台“应用管理>基本信息”中查看对应的ID
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en:
The start time. The following formats are supported:

- UNIX timestamp: the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970.
- Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.help_zh:
开始时间。支持的格式：

- Unix时间戳：从1970年1月1日开始所经过的毫秒数。
- Format格式：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time. The following formats are supported:

- UNIX timestamp: the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970.
- Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.help_zh:
结束时间。支持的格式：

- Unix时间戳：从1970年1月1日开始所经过的毫秒数。
- Format格式：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: end_time
